mapper.select: SELECT id as id ,alias as alias ,notification_title as notificationTitle ,msg_title as msgTitle ,msg_content as msgContent ,extrasparam as extrasparam ,send_time as sendTime ,send_result as sendResult ,fail_reason as failReason ,del_flag as delFlag ,create_by as createBy ,create_time as createTime ,update_by as updateBy ,update_time as updateTime ,dept_id as deptId ,is_read as isRead FROM bs_jpush_record WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND ALIAS = #{alias} AND SEND_RESULT = '1' AND is_read = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
select count(0) from bs_jpush_record T WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND ALIAS = #{alias} AND SEND_RESULT = '1' AND is_read = 0
